sentences.text: This is third application under Section 483 of BNSS filed for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.74/2023 registered at Police Station Amarkantak, District Anuppur (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(2)(n), 506, 323 of IPC and Sections 3, 4, 5, 6 of POCSO Act.

Earlier his first bail application was dismissed by this Court vide order dated 24.01.2024 in M.Cr.C. No.2693/2024 with liberty to renew the prayer after evidence of the prosecutrix before the Trial Court, and second bail application was dismissed for want of prosecution vide order dated 28.11.2024 in M.Cr.C. No.41034/2024.

The applicant is in custody since 22.11.2023.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the present applicant is that he committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix.
On the basis NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:55975 2 MCRC-15574-2025 of which, offence has been registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that the prosecutrix is a consenting party, she was in love affair with the applicant and she left her house and went with the applicant on her own will.

The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time,
therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State as well as learned counsel for the objector have vehemently opposed the bail application and have submitted that the applicant has committed rape upon a minor girl and DNA report is positive.

Therefore, the applicant does not Vipin Kumar Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155310100/
1 deserve grant of bail.

sentences.text: 5. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, taking into account the nature of crime and the allegations made against the present applicant and also the fact that DNA report is positive, it is not a fit case for grant of bail to the applicant.
Consequently, this application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands dismissed.
